title: eBPF-based per-token timing collector, SLI pipeline and multi-region failover runbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Our current token-level SLI collection is app-instrumentation-only and misses sub-ms host/kernel scheduling delays and I/O queuing that can meaningfully inflate tail latency. This causes noisy SLO alerts and ambiguous root-cause attribution during cross-region incidents. Goal: Implement a lightweight eBPF-based microprobe on serving nodes that captures kernel-level timestamps at key boundaries (request ingress, token decode start/end, socket send completion). Build a resilient pipeline to join eBPF events with request/token metadata, expose derived SLIs and heatmaps to Grafana, and author a concrete runbook for using these signals to orchestrate circuit breakers and multi-region failover. The end result should make SLO alerts actionable (clear host vs. runtime vs. network), reduce false positives, and enable automated, safe failover decisions based on cross-layer evidence.
acceptance_criteria: eBPF probe deployed as opt-in daemonset on canary fleet with <5% CPU overhead at 95th percentile
Collected events include stable request_id, token_index, model, region, and kernel timestamps; join success rate > 99% for sampled traffic
Pipeline computes per-token histograms (p50/p95/p99) and publishes Prometheus metrics and ClickHouse aggregates for 30d retention
Grafana dashboard with prefix-aware heatmap, region comparators, and sampled trace playback panel is available and linked to alerts
Runbook defined with concrete threshold definitions, escalation steps, and automated failover gating logic; tested in chaos window without customer-visible impact
Automated canary rollout plan that allows rollback within 15 minutes and does not increase P99 by >5% during rollout
technical_notes: Probe design: use BPF kprobes on hrtimer and tcp_sendmsg + user-space uprobes to mark token boundary events emitted by the runtime to a perf ring buffer
Sampling: default 1% token sampling with adaptive backoff to 0.1% on high CPU; sampled requests carry a sample bit so runtime emits token boundary markers to match kernel events
Join strategy: enrichment service reads eBPF stream from Kafka, joins on request_id+token_index to compute per-token delta values; out-of-order events handled with 200ms sliding window
Privacy/security: eBPF probes only collect event ids and timestamps; no payload/PII is captured; KMS-backed secure transport for pipeline required (see security review)
Storage: raw event subset forwarded to ClickHouse for debug traces; aggregated metrics exported to Prometheus via pushgateway for dashboarding
Failure modes: if join rate drops below 95% fallback to app-only SLI pipeline and emit a diagnostic alert
dashboard_panels: Per-model per-region token p99 heatmap (token index on x, p99 latency on y) with prefix grouping toggles
Prefix / customer cohort comparator: show top-10 prefixes by p99 regression over baseline window
Region delta chart: rolling 1m median difference between host-level p99 and runtime p99; used for failover gating
Sampled trace list: clickable sampled requests that surface eBPF event timeline (ingress -> kernel-sched -> decode-start -> decode-end -> send-complete)
Circuit breaker state panel: current active CBs, reason tags (host-cpu, network, codec), and recent automated transitions
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Spike/proof-of-concept on a single staging pool; validate perf overhead and join logic (2 weeks)
Phase 1: Canary rollout to 2 canary nodes in us-west-2 with 1% sampling; monitor telemetry and rollback if overhead >5% (1 week)
Phase 2: Expand to 10% of serving fleet across two regions; enable dashboards and invite SREs to runbooks testing (2 weeks)
Phase 3: Gradual global rollout with adaptive sampling and alerts live; enable automated CB failover gating behind feature flag (3 weeks)
runbook_summary: Triggering: alert when region delta p99 > 40ms AND host-level p99 increase > 30% over baseline for 3 consecutive 1m windows
Immediate action: divert 20% of traffic away from region to secondary region via routing policies; notify on-call and SRE runbook owner
Escalation: if diverted traffic still shows degraded host-level p99 after 10 minutes, increase diversion to 50% and enable conservative model-variant fallback
Recovery: when region delta p99 returns below 15ms and host p99 within 10% of baseline for 10 minutes, step down diversion in 20% increments
Postmortem: attach sample traces and eBPF event timelines to incident ticket for RCA
security_mitigation: eBPF probe audited for data minimization; no user payloads captured
Probes run as unprivileged BPF with restricted map exports; CI scan before canary rollout
Pipeline transport uses mTLS and KMS-encrypted keys; ClickHouse access limited to oncall group
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: eBPF probe CPU overhead spikes on malformed workloads. Mitigation: adaptive sampling and CPU-based backoff; kill-switch via operator API
Risk: join service becomes a processing hotspot. Mitigation: partition by region + hash(request_id) and autoscale; use Kafka retention tuning
Risk: false-positive failovers due to coarse thresholds. Mitigation: require combined host and kernel evidence and use progressive diversion thresholds
